text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Arima Kinen fast approaching, Special Week summons Grass Wonder to one of the academy's rooftops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's there that Special Week declares her intentions to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder accepts the challenge, assuring her rival that she won't hold anything back either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Many rivals have accompanied her along this path she walks, and the challenge ahead will surely allow her to make another great leap of progress.
